title: Evaluating the Performance of Large Language Models on GAOKAO Benchmark
authors_zh: Xiaotian Zhang 等（School of Computer Science, Fudan University、School of Computer Science and Technology, East China Normal University）
paper_type_zh: arXiv preprint 的 Chinese exam benchmark
best_for_zh: 关注 benchmark、评分契约、污染风险、评测 harness 和后训练反馈可复用性的研究者。
one_line: GAOKAO-Bench evaluates LLMs on Chinese Gaokao objective and subjective exam questions with converted exam scores.
GAOKAO-Bench 用中国高考主客观题评测 LLM，并把人类考试总分与主观题评分一致性纳入审计。
why: It mixes objective and subjective Chinese exam scoring, making grader provenance and score conversion visible.
inclusion_reason: Exam-sourced reasoning surface with strong domain/year metadata needs leakage audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
GAOKAO-Bench evaluates LLMs on Chinese Gaokao objective and subjective exam questions with converted exam scores. The primary sources are arXiv 2305.12474 and the the OpenLMLab GAOKAO-Bench repository.

The concrete problem is how LLMs perform under a Chinese national-exam scoring surface rather than generic NLP tasks. The decision boundary is exam-sourced evaluation, not a reasoning-trace dataset or a universally reusable training set.

The data object or evaluation surface is 2,811 Gaokao questions from 2010-2022 across 9 subjects, including 1,781 objective and 1,030 subjective questions, with answer keys or scoring rubrics. This is useful for the atlas because it makes the feedback contract explicit: objective exact or rule matching, plus subjective human scoring or GPT-4-turbo judge scoring with marking criteria.

GAOKAO-Bench 用中国高考主客观题评测 LLM，并把人类考试总分与主观题评分一致性纳入审计。 主来源是arXiv 2305.12474 和 OpenLMLab GAOKAO-Bench 仓库。

它回答的具体问题是：LLM 在中国国家考试评分面上表现如何，而不是只看通用 NLP 任务。决策边界是考试来源评测，不是 reasoning trace 数据集，也不是可通用复用的训练集。

数据对象或评测面是2010-2022 年 2,811 道高考试题，覆盖 9 个学科，其中 1,781 道客观题、1,030 道主观题，并带答案键或评分 rubric。它对 atlas 的价值在于把反馈契约说清楚：客观题 exact/rule matching，加上主观题人工评分或带 marking criteria 的 GPT-4-turbo judge 评分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is a benchmark that converts model answers into human-exam-style total and subject scores.

The core mechanism is zero-shot model prompting, subject-level grouping, objective scoring, subjective grading, and score conversion. The object being scored is 2,811 Gaokao questions from 2010-2022 across 9 subjects, including 1,781 objective and 1,030 subjective questions, with answer keys or scoring rubrics, and the feedback contract is objective exact or rule matching, plus subjective human scoring or GPT-4-turbo judge scoring with marking criteria.

The closest comparisons are C-Eval, CMMLU, MMLU, and other exam-style benchmarks with less direct Gaokao scoring structure. Its direction label is evaluation-surface and feedback-contract curation rather than generic dataset summarization.

一句话贡献是：把模型答案转换成人类考试风格总分和学科分的 benchmark。

核心机制是zero-shot 模型提示、按学科分组、客观评分、主观评分和分数转换。被评分对象是2010-2022 年 2,811 道高考试题，覆盖 9 个学科，其中 1,781 道客观题、1,030 道主观题，并带答案键或评分 rubric，反馈契约是客观题 exact/rule matching，加上主观题人工评分或带 marking criteria 的 GPT-4-turbo judge 评分。

最近对比对象是C-Eval、CMMLU、MMLU 和其他考试 benchmark；它们没有这么直接的高考评分结构。方向标签是 evaluation surface 与 feedback contract curation，而不是泛泛数据集摘要。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are the task materials and metadata needed to form one record: 2,811 Gaokao questions from 2010-2022 across 9 subjects, including 1,781 objective and 1,030 subjective questions, with answer keys or scoring rubrics.

Pipeline: Collect Gaokao questions; separate subjects and answer types; prompt models; score objective answers with keys; grade subjective answers with human-style rubrics; aggregate converted scores.

Outputs are scored benchmark records or evaluation summaries under this contract: objective exact or rule matching, plus subjective human scoring or GPT-4-turbo judge scoring with marking criteria. Reuse must pin source version, split, scorer or judge version, prompt/scaffold policy, runtime environment where relevant, and artifact license.

输入是一条记录所需的任务材料和元数据：2010-2022 年 2,811 道高考试题，覆盖 9 个学科，其中 1,781 道客观题、1,030 道主观题，并带答案键或评分 rubric。

流程：收集高考试题；区分学科和题型；提示模型作答；客观题按答案键评分；主观题按类人工 rubric 评分；汇总转换分。

输出是在该契约下评分的 benchmark record 或 evaluation summary：客观题 exact/rule matching，加上主观题人工评分或带 marking criteria 的 GPT-4-turbo judge 评分。复用必须固定来源版本、split、scorer 或 judge 版本、prompt/scaffold policy、相关运行环境和 artifact license。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates GPT-4, the OpenAI chat model evaluated in the paper, and ERNIE-Bot, reports converted total scores and subject disparities, and studies moderate consistency between LLM grading and human scores for subjective questions.

The important audit point is the level at which evidence attaches. A benchmark score, judge score, or leaderboard metric is not automatically a row-level verifier certificate unless the source exposes such a verifier.

Score reuse should keep the evaluated split, scorer, model/scaffold settings, and artifact version together with the reported number.

论文评测 GPT-4、论文评测的 OpenAI chat model 和 ERNIE-Bot，报告转换总分和学科差异，并研究 LLM 主观题评分与人类评分的中等一致性。

审计重点是证据附着在哪个层级。benchmark score、judge score 或 leaderboard metric 不会自动变成行级 verifier certificate，除非来源明确公开了这样的 verifier。

复用分数时，应把 evaluated split、scorer、模型/scaffold 设置和 artifact version 与数字一起保存。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior work to compare against includes C-Eval, CMMLU, MMLU, and other exam-style benchmarks with less direct Gaokao scoring structure.

The new surface is a real Chinese Gaokao scoring frame mixing objective and subjective questions.

What is not new: Exam benchmarking and multiple-choice scoring are not new; reuse must inspect exam-year coverage, copyright, scoring rubrics, and subjective-grader agreement.

已有工作主要包括C-Eval、CMMLU、MMLU 和其他考试 benchmark；它们没有这么直接的高考评分结构。

新的评测面是真实中国高考评分框架，并混合客观题和主观题。

不新之处：考试 benchmark 和选择题评分不新；复用要审考试年份覆盖、版权、评分 rubric 和主观题评分者一致性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The score depends on selected exam materials, subject mix, prompt language, answer extraction, and rubric interpretation.

The result should not be read beyond the disclosed source, split, scorer, judge, runtime, or artifact policy. Public releases can also become future training contamination.

If the benchmark signal is reused for training, filtering, or reward design, the feedback contract needs a separate audit from the headline score.

分数依赖所选试题、学科组合、prompt 语言、答案抽取和 rubric 解释。

结论不能超出已披露的来源、split、scorer、judge、runtime 或 artifact policy。公开 release 也可能成为后续模型训练污染。

如果把 benchmark 信号复用到训练、过滤或 reward 设计中，反馈契约需要独立于 headline score 再审一遍。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use it as an exam-derived benchmark schema: exam source, year, subject, item type, answer key, rubric, grader, prompt, and score conversion.

For the atlas, this card is useful because it names the reusable object, the scorer or judge, and the provenance fields that must travel with any downstream score.

A derived recipe should preserve task provenance, split, scorer, judge or verifier version, and any hidden/public boundary.

可作为 exam-derived benchmark schema：考试来源、年份、学科、题型、答案键、rubric、grader、prompt 和分数转换。

对 atlas 来说，这张卡有用，因为它命名了可复用对象、scorer 或 judge，以及任何下游分数必须携带的 provenance 字段。

派生 recipe 应保留任务来源、split、scorer、judge 或 verifier 版本，以及 hidden/public 边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Keep objective answer-key scoring, subjective human scoring, and LLM-as-grader experiments separate.

Read the source sections that define the data object and scorer before reading aggregate results. The most common mistake is to copy a headline score without the split, evaluator, and scaffold assumptions that make the score meaningful.

客观答案键评分、主观人工评分和 LLM-as-grader 实验要分开。

先读定义数据对象和 scorer 的来源章节，再读聚合结果。最常见错误是只搬运 headline score，却丢掉 split、evaluator 和 scaffold 假设。
